# Logs
{: .no_toc }

Find what happened to one request, user or key.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

This screen is part of the **web Hub's Console** and isn't in the Linux, macOS, Windows, iOS or Android apps yet (specs OPEN-QUESTIONS #27).
{: .note }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `OPS-03` |
| **Route** | `/ops/logs` |
| **Where** | Operations › Logs |
| **Who can use it** | operations.view |
| **Kind** | table |
| **Available in** | Web Hub only (Console M3 (web only)) |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules |
|---|---|---|---|
| Query | select + typed fields | a template from the gateway's catalog (by request ID, user, key, status, error code), never free text in v1 | `?request_id=` deep link prefills |
| Range | segmented control | default 24 h | longer ranges warn about query cost |
| Rows | table | timestamp, log group, level, message fields | request ID links to AUD-01 filtered and back |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: progress while the query runs; Empty: "No log lines match."; Error: inline with Retry

## For developers

Loads: `POST /ops/logs/query {template, params, range}` → `GET /ops/logs/query/{id}` (poll every 2 s until complete)

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
